annotations.title: Search jobs across company career sites

description: Search job titles across our index of company career boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and more), newest first: title, company, location, remote flag, salary when published, posting date and job URL. Filter by country, location text, remote, company and posting age. Billed per job returned.

companies.description: Optional company names or board slugs.

countries.description: Optional ISO country codes or names, e.g. US, GB, Germany.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

keywords.description: 1-5 job title terms, e.g. "data engineer". A job matches if its title has all words of any term.

limit.description: Jobs to return in total (default 20, max 50). Billed per job returned.

locations.description: Optional location text, e.g. Berlin, New York, California.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs across company career sites
